'''Brandon9983 good deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Published:''' 1 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
